feeds.title: La Jolla Mom Blog
feeds.description: I'm Katie. I write La Jolla Mom. La Jolla Mom shares the best tips for San Diego vacation planning, luxury hotel perks, travel worldwide, theme park ticket discounts, & much more. I recap our trips and favorite places around the globe. I also talk about our favorite airlines, airport lounges, and gear. My information will help you plan and spend less on traveling.

feeds.title: San Diego Travel Blog
feeds.description: Follow the San Diego Travel Blog for inspiration on activities, attractions, and exclusive deals throughout San Diego County. Your insider guide to San Diego. San Diego's unique blend of wide-open coastline, outdoor lifestyle and feel-good vibes inspires an outlook as sunny as our idyllic weather.

feeds.title: Trips With Tykes
feeds.description: Trips With Tykes is a family travel blog devoted to simplifying the logistics of traveling with young kids. With a little knowledge of airline rules & good planning, family travel can be really fun, even if it still involves the occasional in-flight tantrum or battle with TSA over your toddler's juice box.

feeds.title: Whimsy Soul
feeds.description: Life is short and we believe life is better when you fill it with whimsy. At Whimsy Soul, you can find anything from detailed weekend guides to help you take that last minute road trip, curated style items for all shapes and sizes, easy beauty hacks that make a big difference, even the occasional wine or Netflix recommendation.

feeds.title: The Atlas Heart
feeds.description: Mimi created this space to share local insight, practical travel tips, and everything you need to explore the best of the Golden State. Mimi is an avid traveler, entrepreneur, Californian, and lover of puns, road trips, live music, and sunny destinations.

feeds.title: The LA Girl's Guide » Los Angeles
feeds.description: The LA Girl's guide to things to do in Los Angeles including things to know, expect and love about LA. LA Girl's mission is to inspire discovery in the city of LA and around the world, and to build a community of LA girls that get together and give back.

feeds.title: Visit Oceanside Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with Insider Tips on Oceanside, CA! Get itinerary inspiration for your upcoming vacation and learn more about the city's vibrant arts and culture, delicious dining scene, remarkable history, and more! O'side (as locals affectionately call it) is a destination of discovery where you can explore everything from awe-inspiring sea life through exciting ocean adventures, California history at the 'King of Missions,' and surf culture at the California Surf Museum.

feeds.title: SANDY TOES & POPSICLES Blog
feeds.description: Sandy Toes & Popsicles is an Orange County-based blog founded by Jill Parkin in 2010. The blog offers a variety of resources for parents, including activity ideas, family-friendly events, and reviews of local businesses.

feeds.title: The World Is A Book
feeds.description: An island girl at heart who loves cruising, National Parks & traveling the world with two kids in tow. Sharing our adventures & tips along the way.

feeds.title: California Family Travel
feeds.description: California Family Travel is a family travel blog dedicated to sharing the best destinations and experiences in California. From beaches to theme parks, California has so much to offer.

feeds.title: This Is My Happiness
feeds.description: This Is My Happiness is a travel & lifestyle blog focused on sustainability and living a simple life in Northern California.

feeds.title: California Association of Boutique & Breakfast Inns Blog
feeds.description: CABBI's California travel blog providing inspirational and in-depth reviews of local bed and breakfast inns and boutique hotels.

feeds.title: Hannah on Horizon
feeds.description: California-based Travel Blogger living with lupus. Hi! I'm Hannah, and welcome to my little space. I am Philippines-born, California-raised. I'm here to show you how to travel, dream, and explore within YOUR limits and lifestyle.

feeds.title: What's Gaby Cooking » Travel
feeds.description: Come travel the world with us! As someone who explores via her stomach, Gaby has you covered when it comes to the best places eat, stay and what to do!

feeds.title: California Through My Lens
feeds.description: My name is Josh, and for the last 10 years, I have been exploring as much of California as I possibly can. This site is a collection of those adventures to encourage you to get out and explore California for yourself.

feeds.title: California Crossroads
feeds.description: This California travel blog is dedicated to showcasing the best of the Golden State: from the rugged beaches of the Lost Coast to the sandy shores of San Diego, from the beautiful coastline of Big Sur to the high alpine of the Sierras.

feeds.title: No Back Home Blog
feeds.description: A travel obsessed mom and a nature obsessed son exploring at home in Southern California as well as throughout the world looking for adventure, nature, and a little luxury too!

feeds.title: Bearfoot Theory » California
feeds.description: Learn about California's outdoor activities, national parks & adventure destinations, and start planning your trip with our travel guide & blog posts.

feeds.title: California Crossings
feeds.description: California Crossings is your gateway to the Golden State. Get California travel tips, itineraries and bucket list inspiration. Carol Guttery loves hanging out in California's pine and redwood forests and recently bought a snappy travel van so that we can spend even more time exploring California's hidden corners.

feeds.title: Global Munchkins » California
feeds.description: Amazing things to do in Lake Tahoe in the summer and new port beach that the family will love. Travel within the states, travel California. Global Munchkins is a luxury family travel + lifestyle website. They are passionate about inspiring families to get out & travel as much and as far as they can with their kids in tow.

feeds.title: Hej Doll » Travel
feeds.description: Hej Doll is a travel, life & style blog inspired by the simple modern luxuries found in California and beyond. Jessica Doll is a professional photographer, avid traveller & stylish mama living in the San Francisco Bay area.

feeds.title: Family Road Trip Guru » California
feeds.description: Travel guide for educational, fun, and affordable family road trips in California and beyond. Get detailed kid-friendly itineraries plus a wealth of travel tips.

feeds.title: Life In Wanderlust
feeds.description: My name is Kana and I'm a part-time Travel and Food Blogger, and full-time project manager at a luxury hospitality tech start-up. Life In Wanderlust is a creative outlet for me as i write about my experiences and thoughts on Travel and Food. Grab a cup of tea, browse, and stay a while.

feeds.title: Next with Nicole
feeds.description: A personal lifestyle blog of an adventure-loving, California girl navigating food, travel, nursing, and life in between.

feeds.title: Flashes of Delight
feeds.description: Flashes of Delight is a life & style blog by Barb Lina Dionicio who is passionate about creating memories, family adventures, embracing life, staying authentic, empowering women, and being happy.

feeds.title: Backcountrycow Blog
feeds.description: I'm Alice, a weekend hiker and outdoor adventurer based out of the Bay Area in California. Here you'll find blog posts about some of my favorite backpacking and travel adventures.

feeds.title: JetsetChristina » California
feeds.description: Jetset Christina is a top luxury travel blog with award-winning guides and resources to elevate your travel and lifestyle, every day.

feeds.title: Monterey Blog
feeds.description: Plan your vacation in Monterey, Carmel, Big Sur, Pacific Grove, or Pebble Beach. Find Monterey hotels, things to do, restaurants, beaches and trip ideas.

feeds.title: The Family Travel Guy
feeds.description: A travel advisor blog with hotel reviews and destination information inspiring you to travel better, smarter & help find more value for your money.

feeds.title: American and the Brit » California
feeds.description: Welcome to American and the Brit, exploring the world one country at a time. George and Hanna's passion for travel and seeing the world prompted them to quit their corporate jobs in 2018. They traded their stable lives at home for a life on the road.
